recommendedRankingPolicy: Exclude every deal without an approved payable relationship and exact tracking link.
Score expected DealDesk earnings as commission rate or bounty multiplied by realistic order value and conversion probability.
Balance expected earnings with merchant trust, product demand, discount depth, total customer value, and refund or reversal risk.
Use direct programs when they improve payout, product feeds, or attribution; use aggregator networks for otherwise unavailable retailer coverage.
Never rank a weak customer offer above a genuinely better deal solely because its commission is higher.
